nodes.title: Rejoin upscaled video + original audio latent

widgets_values:
subject_definitions: <Subject 1> is the red panda courier from <Picture 1>: orange-red fluffy fur, white brows, yellow flight goggles on forehead, blue courier uniform with a lightning emblem, mini delivery backpack, and his blue-purple rocket skateboard. <Subject 2> is the mechanical crow drone from <Picture 2>: black rounded metal body, foldable propeller wings, glowing amber mono-eye, oversized clamp claws. <Subject 3> is the sunset rooftop market from <Picture 3>: Chinese-style rooftops strung with warm lanterns and neon signs, bamboo ladders and zip-lines, a giant orange-pink sunset over cotton-candy clouds.

summary: [reference generation] A 15-second 3D cartoon action-comedy chase. <Subject 1> rocket-skateboards across <Subject 3> to deliver a parcel while <Subject 2> dives in hot pursuit; near-misses, a zip-line grind and a slow-motion gap jump build to a triumphant flip landing and a comedic drone crash.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - fur colors, goggles, uniform and skateboard stay identical across all shots.
<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - metal body, amber eye and propeller wings unchanged.
<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3], [Shot 4]): fully_preserved - lantern rooftops, neon signs and sunset palette remain the continuous geography.

detailed_description: A glossy 3D cartoon feature-film look: Pixar-style squash-and-stretch animation, soft global illumination, candy-warm sunset palette, playful motion smears on fast moves.

[Shot 1] At 00:00.000, wide tracking shot, camera dollies left-to-right alongside: <Subject 1> crouches low on his rocket skateboard and launches off a curved roof ridge of <Subject 3>, tail thruster flaring, lantern strings whipping past in warm bokeh; thruster hum and rushing wind.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, low-angle chase shot: <Subject 2> dives into frame from the upper right, claws snapping shut inches behind <Subject 1>'s tail; <Subject 1> swerves under a rooftop neon sign which the drone's wing clips, sparks and cloth fluttering; propeller buzz and a cartoonish clang.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, side-on shot shifting to slow motion: <Subject 1> grinds a zip-line, sparks flying, then kicks off into a stretched gap jump between two rooftops, arms spread, sunset flaring behind him; sound drops to a heartbeat and wind rush.

[Shot 4] At 00:12.000, front medium shot: <Subject 1> lands in a perfect three-point flip landing on the destination roof, whips out the parcel with a proud grin and says, <d>签收啦！</d>; behind him <Subject 2> crashes headfirst into a cloth shop banner and slides down dazed, a tiny steam puff from its tail; comedic crash cymbal and cloth rip.

overall_soundscape: continuous rooftop wind and skateboard thruster hum as the base layer; propeller buzz, snapping claws, clinking lantern strings and a distant market murmur as the mid layer; slow-motion heartbeat and a comedic cymbal crash as accents.

non_diegetic_music: an upbeat playful orchestral-funk chase theme with bouncy bass and taiko drum hits synced to each jump; the music dips under the slow-motion leap and swells into a bright victorious sting on the landing.
